newsitem.title: MEXICO: Apasco says '96 exports 1.2 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Apasco says '96 exports 1.2 mln tonnes.

text.p: Apasco will export 1.2 million tonnes of cement and clinker by the close of 1996, company CEO Pierre A. Froidevaux said on Monday.
"Exports will total a little over 1.2 million tonnes for 1996, and may follow the same trend into 1997," Froidevaux told reporters.
Apasco recently reported nine-month exports of 890,000 tonnes, compared to 136,000 tonnes for the same period in 1995.
Froidevaux said Apasco was planning no major short-term investment as production capacity was enough to meet a recovery in domestic demand.
"We do not have any really significant short-term projects, as we have sufficient capacity," he said.

Froidevaux did not rule out the possibility of a price war between cement makers in Mexico during the rest of the year. When specifically questioned on the possibility of lowering prices, he answered "I don't know, we shall see."
